name: Dungeon Rush
description:
About This Game

DungeonRush is a top-down rogue-like game. You will traverse layers of dungeons, avoid dangerous traps, collect various weapons and equipment, challenge powerful enemies, until you finally confront the evil entity sealed deep within the dungeon.

[ Diverse Weapons & Powerful Items ]

The game features a variety of differentiated weapons, each offering unique attack styles, combat feel, and powerful skills. Combine them with various runes and items to perfect your build and face the challenges of the dungeon head-on!

[Strategic Upgrades & Inventory Management]

Stack and upgrade duplicate runes to grow stronger, but beware of limited inventory space. With weapons subject to durability, carrying a diverse arsenal and carefully managing your resources and storage is the key to surviving deeper into the dungeon!

[Epic Boss Battles & Lucrative Rewards]

At the end of every dungeon floor, you must confront formidable bosses designed to test your skills. Great peril brings great returns—slaying the boss yields abundant rewards and crucial resources for permanent upgrades.

[Meta-Progression & Loadout Selection]

There is no failure, only growth! Unlock permanent upgrades between runs, select your go-to starting weapons and gear, and gear up for your next descent into the dungeon!
